subject: QuantaHealth CAIQ assertion roadmap and telemetry sampler
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie@quantahealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: security@quantahealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ mapping + evidence for upcoming vendor review

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re doing well. We’re starting our vendor security review for Q1 and would like Redwood’s CAIQ/CSA responses and a small evidence package so our audit team can validate a few controls. Specifically we need:

- A control mapping (CAIQ questions -> Redwood control / artifact) focusing on tenant isolation, KMS/HSM key rotation, telemetry/observability (runtime logs, tracing), and encryption-at-rest for embeddings.
- A short sample of runtime telemetry logs (redacted) showing request traces and tenant identifiers (if available) or an explanation if identifiers are not present.
- Proof of key rotation policy and an example rotation event (audit entry) or equivalent HSM/KMS artifact.

Can you confirm whether these can be delivered by next week? Also please send any CAIQ spreadsheet you maintain so our compliance team can start annotating.

Thanks — Julie
Julie Park
Senior Information Security Manager
QuantaHealth

---
Attachment: quanta_vendor_review_scope.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Park <julie@quantahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + evidence for upcoming vendor review

Julie — thanks for the clear ask. We can do this.

Plan (high level):
1) Share an internal CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (columns: CAIQ ID, Redwood assertion, control owner, artifact sample) by EOD tomorrow.
2) Provide a redacted telemetry sample and short explainer from our runtime by Friday (we’ll redact PII/PHI). Rishi will generate the trace extract.
3) Marissa will assemble the evidence bundle (policy PDF, excerpted logs, annotated screenshots) and Kimberly will provide a short control narrative for tenant isolation and KMS handling.

Questions for you: which CAIQ sections should we prioritize in the mapping (network & tenancy isolation, cryptography, and logging are good candidates but want to confirm)? Do you need the artifacts uploaded to a shared drive or delivered as an attachment bundle?

Attachments: redwood-caiq-mapping-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet) and runtime-telemetry-sample.txt (text) — these are early drafts.

I’ll kick off internal owners now and aim for a consolidated package by 2026-01-18.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood-caiq-mapping-draft.xlsx, runtime-telemetry-sample.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Park <julie@quantahealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + evidence for upcoming vendor review

Julie / team — I put together an annotated mapping and a short evidence checklist to speed your review. Key notes:

- Tenant isolation: our hosted offering segments requests at the control plane and runtime; the annotated mapping points to control owners and the runtime isolation design doc.
- KMS/HSM: we use cloud KMS with customer-segregated key aliases for Dedicated/Private. The rotation policy is company-controlled; sample rotation event (audit id) will be provided as a redacted PDF.
- Telemetry: we can include request traces but we do not persist customer prompt text in logs for hosted accounts; tenant id is present as a hashed identifier in our trace context.

I attached redwood_caiq_annotated_mapping_v1.xlsx and a quick checklist that shows the artifacts we’ll include in the package. If QuantaHealth requires DocuSign for a minimal SLA addendum, ping legal and we’ll route it.

Marissa Cole
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: redwood_caiq_annotated_mapping_v1.xlsx

From: Julie Park <julie@quantahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: security@quantahealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + evidence for upcoming vendor review

Thanks Marissa, Aditya — this looks great and is the right level of detail. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

1) KMS rotation evidence — can you provide either (a) an exportable audit entry showing a rotation event (redacted timestamps/ARNs OK), or (b) a signed policy PDF plus a console screenshot that shows the rotation schedule?
2) Telemetry — the hashed tenant id is fine, but we’ll need a short note confirming no customer prompt text in hosted logs and a sample trace showing the hashed tenant id mapping.
3) Timeline — we need the final CAIQ package by COB 2026-01-20 to satisfy our audit window. Is that still achievable?

We’re happy with a shared Drive link for artifacts. Also, please include any DocuSign or contract instrument if you propose the SLA addendum.

Julie Park
Senior Information Security Manager
QuantaHealth

- Final CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (annotated): redwood_caiq_annotated_mapping_v1.xlsx
- Evidence bundle (PDFs + screenshots): kms-rotation-policy.pdf (policy excerpt + signed cover), kms_rotation_event_redacted.pdf (single audit event), telemetry_trace_sample_redacted.txt (trace showing hashed tenant id), runtime-telemetry-sample.txt (raw trace excerpt), control_narrative_tenancy.pdf
